mapper.select: SELECT activity_evaluation.id, activity_evaluation.activity_id, activity_evaluation.username, activity_evaluation.score, activity_evaluation.content, activity_evaluation.create_time FROM activity_evaluation WHERE activity_evaluation.activity_id = #{activityId} AND activity_evaluation.deleted_flag = 0 ORDER BY activity_evaluation.create_time DESC

SELECT activity_evaluation.id, activity_evaluation.activity_id, activity_evaluation.username, activity_evaluation.score, activity_evaluation.content, activity_evaluation.create_time, activity.title AS activity_title, activity.cover_img FROM activity_evaluation LEFT JOIN activity ON activity.id = activity_evaluation.activity_id WHERE activity_evaluation.user_id = #{userId} AND activity_evaluation.deleted_flag = 0 ORDER BY activity_evaluation.create_time DESC

SELECT activity.id AS activity_id, activity.title, activity.cover_img, activity_schedule.activity_end_time FROM activity_enrollment INNER JOIN activity ON activity.id = activity_enrollment.activity_id AND activity.deleted_flag = 0 AND activity.status = 4 LEFT JOIN activity_schedule ON activity_schedule.activity_id = activity.id WHERE activity_enrollment.user_id = #{userId} AND activity_enrollment.deleted_flag = 0 AND activity_enrollment.sign_in_status = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM activity_evaluation WHERE activity_evaluation.activity_id = activity_enrollment.activity_id AND activity_evaluation.user_id = activity_enrollment.user_id AND activity_evaluation.deleted_flag = 0 ) ORDER BY activity_schedule.activity_end_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM activity_enrollment INNER JOIN activity ON activity.id = activity_enrollment.activity_id AND activity.deleted_flag = 0 AND activity.status = 4 WHERE activity_enrollment.user_id = #{userId} AND activity_enrollment.deleted_flag = 0 AND activity_enrollment.sign_in_status = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM activity_evaluation WHERE activity_evaluation.activity_id = activity_enrollment.activity_id AND activity_evaluation.user_id = activity_enrollment.user_id AND activity_evaluation.deleted_flag = 0 )
